text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's the beginning of Manhattan Cafe's senior year, and we've come to the shrine to pray for her success.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Um… where's Tachyon? She usually comes along whether we invite her or not.
choice_data_list: She said she was too busy.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: A shrine visit? Sorry, but my research schedule is fairly hectic at the moment.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Now that Cafe's condition has improved, the stress on her toenails and sesamoids has increased immensely! Almost comically so.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Well, I'll see what I can do. And I don't think I need to tell you, but not a word of this to anyone.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: If anyone asks after me, just tell them that I caught a cold and am sleeping in a hotel.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Agnes Tachyon is looking out for Manhattan Cafe in her own way.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: So that leaves the two of us today… For some reason, my friend isn't here either…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Manhattan Cafe has been acting strange ever since the Arima Kinen. She's not usually like this.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's normally quite even-tempered, but…

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: Okay, everyone, it's time for your New Year prayers! Remember, the gods will grant any wish you make!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Lies.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: No one will see their wishes come true. There are no peaceful gods here to grant them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Still… sometimes she gets like this. Maybe there's some kind of trigger?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, this way… Let's go.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …To the town that will grant any wish we make.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She takes me to a strange town that feels a million miles away from the bustle of the New Year festivities.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: This is the only place where your wishes really will come true…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: What will you wish for me, Trainer? …To help me catch up to my friend.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Choose from among those that emerge before you…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Just then, some strange text appears at my feet. Trembling, I make my choice…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Soothing… Yes… The stars watch over us…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If we bathe our bodies in the light of the unyielding stars…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Trainer. My body feels a little revitalized…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: I'll be able to focus on training now. I'll look ahead… and move forward…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Was that town an illusion? …Whatever the truth may be, the life has come back to Manhattan Cafe's face.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: A body covered in scales… Covering my hair… my retinas… my soul…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If only I could expand my very existence. Ah…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sploosh!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The night sea. I dream that I am sinking beneath the waves. Falling… endlessly…

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Oh, how strange. My measurements are telling me that your muscle strength and endurance have improved, Cafe.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Did you do some training during your shrine visit?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: We didn't do any training. But it does look like that wish had some kind of effect.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The wisdom of the departed… The memories of our predecessors…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: If only we could look into the past… Just a glimpse would be enough…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Memories I could never have known flood my mind.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Sights I'm not sure even existed… Ancient knowledge of them…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I'm starting to believe there are many styles of running. I wish to…

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Try out these… new methods in my races…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A flash of history. Perhaps Manhattan Cafe witnessed something only her eyes could see.
